evidencePolicy: Only completed human review, pilot, calibration, standard-setting, security, privacy and release-approval evidence may advance a gate. Repository structure, generated files, synthetic records, passing CI, or course completion alone must not close a release gate.
requiredEvidence: validated job-task analysis and SME/employer validation
new secure operational item bank in an approved private assessment store
explicit versioned final program release approval
prohibitedShortcuts: Do not treat green CI as certification approval.
Do not use public ITEM-TECH1 development items as the secure operational credential bank.
Do not create synthetic human review, pilot, calibration or approval evidence to close gates.
Do not expose secure operational answer keys or credential forms in the public repository.
Do not issue the credential while any required release gate is unresolved.
